_doc: CR264 - controls the exhaustive crawler must NEVER press automatically. Key = accessibility id or exact label (case-insensitive); '<screen id>#<key>' scopes to one screen; a '~' before the key makes it a label substring. Value = the reason, copied into control_coverage.json and counted as an exemption. Keep this short: everything else is pressed (destructive ones LAST, then the app is reset).
Send report: submits a real bug report to the shared triage queue; the crawler rig has no admin credentials to auto-resolve it afterwards (the API layer, UAT-SUPP-001/002, already exercises submission)
Take photo: opens the system camera/permission UI, which the driver cannot return from reliably
Choose from library: opens the system photo picker, outside the app's accessibility tree
ami.screen.upgrade_paywall#~buy: real-money purchase (Trader / Floor Manager / credit packs); the sandbox purchase is a manual iPhone case
ami.screen.upgrade_paywall#~credit: credit pack purchase: real money, sandbox purchase is a manual iPhone case
ami.screen.upgrade_paywall#~trader: plan purchase: real money, sandbox purchase is a manual iPhone case
ami.screen.upgrade_paywall#~floor manage: plan purchase: real money, sandbox purchase is a manual iPhone case
~open settings: jumps to the OS Settings app, which the driver cannot return from
~open in browser: leaves the app for an external browser
